sources.label: Morphe patches for Keyflow (com.angkin.keyflow) 1.5.8 - PairIP, signer-identity,
sources.author: Keyflow
patch_list: [ALL] PairIP License Check
Neuters PairIP license verification using fingerprint matching (version-robust).
[ALL] Pro Unlock
Forces all Pro features enabled using fingerprint matching (version-robust for method name changes).
[ALL] Signer Identity
Forces the app's signer identity to match the original publisher certificate (fingerprint-based, version-robust).
[Export] 1 kts6dAU4 Gate
Always allow Pro features in the export Pro gate (Lkts6dAU4.NMGZ06).
[Export] 10 LP4eSlPPu Allow
Always allow an individual Pro feature (LP4eSlPPu.invoke).
[Export] 2 kts6dAU4 Throw
Do not throw the Pro-required exception (LwNKvkk7) during export.
[Export] 3 y88yfJ73C Allow
Always let the export pass the LCtCUGg.y88yfJ73C abort check.
[Export] 4 ZFJe6vx50 Skip
Never take the export-abort branch in LZFJe6vx50.invoke.
[Export] 5 kCg72Z4t State
Publish PLAYING instead of PRO_REQUIRED/ERROR as export state.
[Export] 6 LCWcMAXf Error
Pass a null error message into the pre-export step.
[Export] 7 LsvcJNUbK3 Allow
Always allow the LsvcJNUbK3 sub-check of the export Pro gate.
[Export] 8 Diagnostics
Log every export Pro gate decision to logcat (tag KFPro). Read with: adb logcat -s KFPro
[Export] 9 Toast
Show a toast naming the reason the export was cancelled.
Keyflow byYKY0yXO Signer Bypass
Return a dummy signer identity string during export so the export path does not fail on re-signed APKs.
Keyflow Export Pro Gate Bypass
Allows exporting projects that use Pro features by bypassing the Pro gate in the export pipeline.
Keyflow f6olX Goto Fix
Replaces failure goto sites in f6olX with nop so all code paths reach Premium (Keyflow 1.5.10 export).
Keyflow Trusted Signer Bypass
Always report the app signature as trusted so Pro is not reset when opening a project or exporting.
PairIP License Check
Neuters PairIP license verification so the app runs without a valid license.
Pro Unlock
Forces all Pro features enabled and replaces the Google Play confirmation with a fake success, so ad surfaces never appear.
Signer Identity
Forces the app's signer identity to match the original publisher certificate.
